claim: P1 engineering same-contract non-inferiority for HYLE public HTTP/2 multiplex and two-level flow-control journeys against direct pinned nghttp2 sessions on equivalent one-worker runtimes

configuration.delivery_shape: clean source-pinned static libnghttp2 built in the candidate CMake graph
configuration.route: public nghttp2 session, HPACK, frame, stream and flow-control APIs plus a bounded benchmark-only transport adapter
configuration.progress: one persistent dedicated worker and one external admitting and waiting caller
configuration.transport: fresh nonblocking Unix socket pair with identical 4 KiB socket buffers per episode

ownership_topology.candidate: One external owner admits HYLE client and server Tasks to one persistent Scheduler/IoContext worker, waits through JoinHandles and retires session state after 64 streams
ownership_topology.peer: One external owner dispatches direct nghttp2 client/server sessions to one persistent worker, waits through a bounded condition handoff and retires session state after 64 streams
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both retain runtime and payloads outside timing; charge a fresh local transport, identical sequential fixed-body production within each two-stream overlap, reverse completion, full validation and session retirement

material_contribution.denominator: one warm multiplexed inference HTTP/2 connection episode
material_contribution.derivation: HTTP/2 inference frontends multiplex overlapping request lifetimes and streaming responses over retained connections

workloads.semantic_contract: On one fresh h2c connection, complete and byte-validate 64 POST request-response streams in pairs with 1 KiB request and response bodies, two active streams and deliberately reversed response completion

input.distribution: fixed request and response bytes with deterministic method, path, authority and status

workloads.setup: Construct persistent one-worker runtimes and immutable payloads, then complete one route-ordered warmup episode before timing
charged_phases: per-connection transport and HTTP/2 session construction
64 request header blocks plus complete body production, parse and validation
64 response header blocks plus incremental body consumption and exact validation
stream and connection-state teardown plus external completion handoff

ownership_topology.candidate: The same persistent HYLE owner consumes 256 KiB bodies through public bounded body readers and returns stream and connection credit
ownership_topology.peer: The same persistent direct-nghttp2 owner consumes identical DATA callbacks and returns the two credits explicitly
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both charge four streams in pairs, identical 64 KiB stream and 65,535-byte connection windows, identical bytes, progress, reverse response order, validation and teardown

material_contribution.denominator: one large-body HTTP/2 flow-control connection episode
material_contribution.derivation: Large prompt and transfer-control bodies must repeatedly replenish both HTTP/2 window levels rather than pass only a small-message fast path

workloads.semantic_contract: On one fresh h2c connection, complete and byte-validate four POST request-response streams in pairs with 256 KiB per direction, 64 KiB stream windows and a 65,535-byte connection window that force both WINDOW_UPDATE paths

input.distribution: fixed deterministic bodies larger than both advertised receive windows

workloads.setup: Reuse the same persistent runtimes and route-ordered warmup rule as the normal workload
charged_phases: per-connection transport and HTTP/2 session construction
request and response HPACK and frame work
2 MiB of total body production, transport, incremental consumption and exact validation
stream and connection WINDOW_UPDATE generation and processing
reverse completion, state retirement and external completion handoff
